titulo_es.@es: Seguir referencias y conectores en textos largos
titulo_es.@en: Follow references and connectors in long texts

하지만 도로는 여전히 막혀요.en: But the roads are still congested

그래서 주차장을 줄이자는 의견이 나왔어요.es: Por eso surgió la propuesta de reducir el aparcamiento
그래서 주차장을 줄이자는 의견이 나왔어요.en: That's why the proposal to reduce the parking lot came up.

texto.@es: Los conectores marcan causa, contraste y conclusión; sigue sus relaciones para no atribuir una razón a la frase equivocada.
texto.@en: The connectors mark cause, contrast and conclusion; follow their relationships so as not to attribute a reason to the wrong phrase.

texto.@es: 버스가 늘었어요. 하지만 도로는 여전히 막혀요. 그래서 주차장을 줄이자는 의견이 나왔어요. = Aumentaron los autobuses. Pero las carreteras siguen congestionadas. Por eso surgió la propuesta de reducir el aparcamiento.
texto.@en: 버스가 늘었어요. 하지만 도로는 여전히 막혀요. 그래서 주차장을 줄이자는 의견이 나왔어요= = The buses have increased. But the roads are still congested. That's why the proposal to reduce the parking lot came up.
